name: WebGL Multi-pass Ray-casting with 3D Geometry Intersection
aliases: WebGL volume rendering with intersected 3D geometry
definition: A WebGL-based volume rendering algorithm that supports the coexistence of 3D triangular meshes and volumetric datasets by using a five-pass rendering pipeline to handle occlusion, blending, and ray intersection with 3D geometry within WebGL constraints (lack of 3D textures and limited depth texture support).
summary: This five-pass WebGL pipeline renders semi-transparent volumes alongside opaque 3D meshes by encoding depth into RGBA textures to enable ray-geometry intersection checks.
